key.name: difficulty
key.description: Search depth and time budget used by the computer opponent.

key.name: learning-mode
key.description: Rank the player's moves before each turn and explain the best one.

key.name: show-seed-counts
key.description: Show the number of seeds under each house and above each store, as well as drawing the seeds themselves. The counts are always available to a screen reader whatever this is set to.

key.name: language
key.description: Language to show the interface in, or "system" to follow the desktop. Applied when the application starts.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Width of the main window in logical pixels.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Height of the main window in logical pixels.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the main window was maximized when it was closed.

key.name: saved-start
key.summary: Starting position of the game in progress
key.description: Position the saved game began from, written in the notation of docs/RULES.md section 8. Empty when there is no game to restore.

key.name: saved-moves
key.summary: Moves played in the game in progress
key.description: Houses played since the starting position, in order. Replaying these over the starting position restores the game exactly, including its undo history and its repetition count.
